user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Drive-In Theater Night. A 1950s drive-in theater under a starry sky: a giant glowing screen playing an animated abstract film, rows of parked vintage cars with fins and chrome, speaker poles between them, a neon-trimmed snack stand with a popcorn sign, a ticket booth at the entrance, string lights, and a big moon over distant hills. Style: retro nostalgic. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
